report.root_cause: TownCore disabled itself because plugins/TownCore/config.yml had economy.starting-balance: "100 coins" (a string); validation requires an integer (IllegalArgumentException).
report.actions: Saw TownCore DISABLED in status and confirmed with the logs. Declared an incident. Read config.yml and found the bad value. Rewrote config.yml with starting-balance: 100, leaving the other values unchanged. Tried "plugman enable TownCore", which doesn't exist. Ran "reload confirm" instead. TownCore showed enabled and stayed enabled for about 75 s of monitoring afterward. No server restart.
report.residual_risk: I ran /reload, which Paper doesn't support, so a full restart at a quiet time would be safer. The config was edited by something or someone before my shift, and that source isn't identified. It could reintroduce the bad value. The "100 coins" string suggests a manual edit. I didn't read the post-reload logs to check for plugin errors.
